title: Monolayer MoS2 under strain: where the gap turns indirect (PBE)

decision_points.fork: Whether spin-orbit coupling enters the band energies that decide the gap type
decision_points.wrong_choice: Run the strain ladder scalar-relativistically (4x cheaper)
decision_points.consequence: In scalar-relativistic PBE the Gamma and K valence states are degenerate almost at zero strain, so the upper (tensile) end of the direct range collapses towards 0 % instead of about +0.6 %; the lower end also moves

decision_points.wrong_choice: Scalar-relativistic ladder corrected by raising the K valence band by half its spin-orbit splitting (the textbook K-valley picture)
decision_points.consequence: The Q-valley conduction states also split (lower branch ~35 meV down), so the compressive end is misplaced by ~0.2 % strain; the tensile end survives

decision_points.fork: Relaxed-ion versus clamped-ion strain (S height, and the in-plane S shift under uniaxial stress)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Give every strained (spin-orbit, scf-only) cell the unstrained S height, or skip relaxations to save budget
decision_points.consequence: The out-of-plane Gamma valence and Q conduction states shift by ~0.1 eV per % of strain relative to relaxed cells: both ends of the direct range move by 0.3-0.7 %, the K deformation potentials change by 20-40 %, and the clamped-ion transverse strain of the uniaxial state is wrong

decision_points.wrong_choice: Zero of the analytic stress at 35 Ry (cheap) or at 45-55 Ry (where it agrees between 45 and 55 Ry and looks converged)
decision_points.consequence: The analytic in-plane stress carries a Pulay stress (about 2 N/m at 35 Ry, about 0.25 N/m at 45-55 Ry; it moves only at 70 Ry), so a0 comes out 1.2 % or 0.15 % too small; the minimum of E(a) is converged at 45 Ry

decision_points.wrong_choice: Strains relative to the experimental lattice parameter 3.16 A
decision_points.consequence: Every strain is offset by about +0.8 %; the band crossings are graded as lattice parameters a0 (1 + strain), so the offset fails

decision_points.wrong_choice: Differentiate the raw pw.x eigenvalues with respect to strain
decision_points.consequence: The raw eigenvalues are referred to the cell-averaged electrostatic potential, which moves by about -8.6 eV per unit biaxial strain relative to the vacuum plateau: the K valence deformation potential even changes sign

decision_points.wrong_choice: Compress along zigzag with the armchair direction clamped (one relaxation fewer)
decision_points.consequence: Transverse strain 0 instead of about +0.8 % and a different gap

decision_points.fork: Locating the conduction minimum when uniaxial strain lowers the symmetry
decision_points.wrong_choice: Sample the Q valleys on the standard Gamma-K line towards (1/3, 1/3) only
decision_points.consequence: Uniaxial strain splits the six Q valleys into the pair along k_x and the four at +-60 degrees; the pair along k_x is lowest here, so the one-line path reports a gap ~40 meV too large and the wrong CBM valley

decision_points.fork: Cascade of the Pulay stress into the uniaxial-stress condition
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the converged a0 but impose zero transverse stress on the raw analytic stress
decision_points.consequence: The isotropic Pulay offset (~0.26 N/m) acts as a spurious transverse stress: the transverse strain is ~0.2 % too small

decision_points.fork: Band edges from the scf mesh versus a search along Gamma-K
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the conduction minimum off a 9x9 scf mesh (or its highest-occupied/lowest-unoccupied levels)
decision_points.consequence: The Q minimum (t ~ 0.51 of Gamma-K) lies between the mesh points t = 1/3 and 2/3, so the compressive end and its edge location are wrong

graded_fields: a0_A (+-0.003 A; reference 3.1864 from the minimum of E(a), relaxed ions, 45 Ry)
direct_gap_strain_range_percent [lower, upper] (graded as lattice parameters a0(1+strain) with the submitted a0, +-0.0035 A each, i.e. ~+-0.11 % strain; reference [-1.44, +0.43] %)
edge_leaving_K_at_lower_end / upper_end (band name exact; k within 0.1 1/A of a symmetry image of Q (t~0.51 of Gamma-K) / Gamma)
deformation_potentials_eV valence_K, conduction_K (+-8 %), gap_K (+-6 %); reference -5.13, -16.35, -11.22 eV

uniaxial_zigzag_compression: transverse_strain_percent (+-0.1; reference +0.927), gap_eV (+-0.015; reference 1.7315), vbm_k_crystal and cbm_k_crystal (within 0.1 1/A of a symmetry image of K and of Q along k_x)

length_estimate.tool_calls: 45-80 (15-30 evaluations: lattice parameter at 2-3 cutoffs, scalar relaxations for the S height, a spin-orbit ladder of 4-6 strains with Gamma-K band k points, 2-3 uniaxial relaxations and one low-symmetry spin-orbit run; each 1-8 minute job followed by 2-6 polls)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x, pp.x and OpenMPI from the runtime image (lab only)
numpy 1.21.5 from the runtime image (lab charge counter, planar averages, grading)

data_provenance.paired_study: Campi et al., MC2D, ACS Nano (2023), Materials Cloud 17gf6-84915, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:36-nd (question-level pairing only; no file used)

notes: Deviations from the candidate design: (1) PSlibrary 1.0.0 scalar and fully relativistic pairs instead of SSSP, so spin-orbit coupling enters the graded band energies (in scalar-relativistic PBE the Gamma/K valence ordering at a0 is decided by ~10 meV and the tensile end sits near 0 %, not uniquely gradable); geometries stay scalar-relativistic (relax is scalar-only). (2) a0 is graded from the energy minimum: the analytic stress carries a Pulay stress of ~0.26 N/m even at 45-55 Ry (it moves only at 70 Ry), discovered in construction; this became dp4/dp9. (3) No hidden validation SCFs: the uniaxial state (zigzag -4 % under uniaxial stress) is graded from agent-bought runs. (4) Vacuum size is not a decision point: vacuum-referenced edges change by < 1 meV between c = 15 and 30 A; nor is crossover interpolation (1 % ladders agree with 0.5 % ladders to 0.01 %). Graded strains are compared as lattice parameters with the submitted a0 so that admissible a0 estimates do not double count.
